data.title: 妮姆芙 · 铁塔暮云端的苹果糖恋歌
data.action: 坐在水塔边缘，双手捏着薯片袋，双马尾在晚风中扬起，透明电子羽翼微颤，泪眼汪汪地别过头娇嗔。
data.location: 小镇最高处生锈水塔圆顶，晚霞如火烧云般铺满整片地平线
data.lighting: 浓烈的夕阳橙紫反光照亮电子翅膀，在半透明翅膜上折射出虹彩数码光效
data.mood: 傲娇电子天使的纯情与执拗，暮色下让人怦然心动的脆弱
data.description: 小镇最高处生锈水塔圆顶，晚霞如火烧云般铺满整片地平线。坐在水塔边缘，双手捏着薯片袋，双马尾在晚风中扬起，透明电子羽翼微颤，泪眼汪汪地别过头娇嗔。 她微微抬眸轻语——“笨蛋……低等下仆！才没有特意打扮成这样给你看呢……把那边的苹果糖递给我啦！”
data.promptProse: Seated along the rusted dome of the town's highest water tower at sunset, Nymph wears a sky-blue translucent chiffon frilled playsuit with an open back and golden bell choker. Clutching a bag of potato chips while turning away with a teary pout, she glows against fiery orange-and-purple dusk clouds shimmering across her translucent wings.
data.animaCaption: Seated atop the curved dome of a rusted water tower clutching a snack bag in her translucent sky-blue chiffon frilled playsuit and gold bell choker, she turns away with a teary, pouting blush as evening wind lifts her hair. Fiery sunset light turns her electronic wings iridescent.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sky-blue translucent chiffon frilled playsuit with an open back for her wings, ruffled boyleg shorts, and a golden bell choker.
